metadata.title: OpenCouncil MCP — Ask your AI assistant about your municipality
metadata.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any AI assistant you use to OpenCouncil and ask what is being discussed and decided in municipal councils.

hero.title: Ask your AI assistant about your municipality
hero.lead: Give ChatGPT or Claude access to OpenCouncil, and ask where you already ask.

video.watch: Watch the video (4 min, in Greek)

claude.title: Claude
claude.step3: Name it OpenCouncil and paste the address. Leave the other fields empty.
claude.step4: Click "Add", then "Connect" — the connector shows as connected.
claude.mobileNotice: You cannot add a custom connector from the Claude mobile app — only from claude.ai in a browser or the desktop app. Once added, it works on mobile too, as long as you are signed in to the same account.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
chatgpt.step1: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps & Connectors and enable Developer mode (under Advanced).
chatgpt.step2: Go back to Apps & Connectors and click "Create".
chatgpt.step3: Name it OpenCouncil, paste the address, and choose "No authentication".
chatgpt.step4: Click "Create", then "Connect" — the connector shows as connected.

tokens.title: Personal access
tokens.description: With an OpenCouncil account, your assistant can additionally save highlights in your name: selected excerpts from a meeting's records. Create a personal MCP address and use it instead of the public one.
tokens.signInPrompt: Sign in to create your personal address.
tokens.createdNote: Copy it now — it is shown only once. Treat it like a password: anyone who has it acts as you on OpenCouncil. You can revoke it at any time.
tokens.empty: You have not created a personal address yet.

examples.title: Then just ask
examples.lead: Your assistant reads the same public record the site shows, and cites where every answer came from.
examples.example1: What were the most important topics in Attica's municipalities last week?
examples.example2: What has the municipal administration said about childcare centres? Show me exactly what was said.
examples.example3: Draft a social media post with the key positions from the latest council meeting.
examples.example4: What has the council discussed about my neighbourhood?
